notes.title: fs.rs is 9.7k LOC
notes.body: Every file/dir form lives in one module: reader/writers, diff walking, watchers, and path safety — the hot seam for splitting.

notes.title: commands cover ~10 domains
notes.body: lib.rs aggregates 308 #[tauri::command] fns across fs, harness, git, notes, ios/mobile, tray, searches, and notification surfaces.

notes.title: checkpoint discipline
notes.body: checkpoint.rs snapshots ahead of each mutation; rust side owns writes, TS only maps UI semantics.
